notes: the saying is Abu Awana's own statement: «ما بلغني عن الحسن حديث إلا أتيت به أبان بن أبي عياش فقرأه على»; «بلغني» is a gap (rule 8) and Hasan is named as the subject, so the chain does not join to Hasan
Aban b. Abi Ayyash is a figure in the statement who read the hadith to Abu Awana; rule 6 says not to add a scene figure without a ruling
no Prophet in this report; the chain ends at Abu Awana
